# Audit IModule Mocks

This directory contains auto-generated mocks for the audit module's repository interfaces.

##  Important: DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

All files in this directory are **auto-generated by mockery**. Any manual changes will be overwritten.

## Generating Mocks

### Regenerate Audit Mocks Only

```bash
make mocks-audit
```

### Regenerate All Mocks

```bash
make mocks
```

## Usage in Tests

```go
import (
    "github.com/basilex/promenade/internal/modules/audit/domain/repository/mocks"
)

func TestAuditEventUseCase_GetEvent(t *testing.T) {
    // Create mock
    mockRepo := new(mocks.MockAuditEventRepository)

    // Set expectations
    expectedEvent := &entity.AuditEvent{ID: "test-id"}
    mockRepo.On("GetByID", mock.Anything, "test-id").Return(expectedEvent, nil)

    // Create use case
    uc := NewAuditEventUseCase(mockRepo)

    // Test
    result, err := uc.GetEvent(ctx, "test-id")

    // Assertions
    require.NoError(t, err)
    assert.Equal(t, expectedEvent, result)
    mockRepo.AssertExpectations(t)
}
```

## When to Regenerate

Run `make mocks-audit` after:

- Adding new methods to `IAuditEventRepository`
- Changing method signatures
- Modifying return types

## Configuration

Mock generation is configured in the root `.mockery.yaml` file:

```yaml
packages:
  github.com/basilex/promenade/internal/modules/audit/domain/repository:
    config:
      all: true
      dir: internal/modules/audit/domain/repository/mocks
```
